title: Customer Service
description: For school leavers who want to work with people – in shops, offices, call centres or remote support roles. You will learn how to listen, communicate on phone, WhatsApp and email, handle complaints and difficult customers calmly, and use feedback to help a business grow.
outcomes: Explain why good service matters and show a service mindset
Listen actively and ask the right questions to understand a customer
Communicate professionally by phone, WhatsApp and email
Handle complaints and difficult customers calmly using a clear method
Collect and use customer feedback in a small business
Prepare for customer service and remote support jobs
